important_instructions: Only income certificates issued in accordance with the UP Government Revenue Section-9 order No. 3959/1-9-11-Ra0-9, dated 30.09.2011, and capable of online verification from the competent authority, will be considered valid. As per the Social Welfare Section-2 order No. 22/2015/2123/26-2-2015, dated 14 September 2015 (as amended), the annual income limit for the Below Poverty Line category is ₹46,080 for rural areas and ₹56,460 for urban (non-rural) areas. The income certificate must be valid as on the last date for receipt of applications, and must have been issued within three years prior to the date of publication of this notification; an income certificate older than 3 years, issued under the BPL category standard, will be treated under the APL category. Only residence and caste certificates issued through the Tehsil's online digital-signature system, capable of online verification, will be considered valid.

All selection proceedings will be governed by the decisions of the Selection Committee constituted under Government Order No. I/2025/3313/58-1-2025 (1917687), dated 17 September 2025, issued by the Principal Secretary, Bal Vikas Seva evam Pushtahar, Uttar Pradesh. Government Orders relating to Scheduled Caste, Scheduled Tribe, and Other Backward Class reservation will be followed in the appointment of Anganwadi Karyakartri and Sahayika, as per the selection Government Order. The number of vacancies may increase or decrease, and this will be reflected on the website. If any error comes to light regarding vacancies and reservation, a decision will be taken only after resolution, and the department's decision on this will be final. For further details on eligibility and the application process, candidates may contact the Bal Vikas Pariyojana office of their Vikas Khand, or the office of the District Programme Officer (Bal Vikas Vibhag, 2nd Floor, Vikas Bhavan, near Mandi Samiti, Aligunj Road, Etah) on working days.

content_sections.heading: Etah Anganwadi Karyakartri & Sahayika Recruitment 2026 Notification Out
content_sections.text: The District Programme Officer, Etah, has issued a press notification (Patrank: /Ji0Ka0Adhi0/Vigyapti/2026-27, dated 28 July 2026) inviting online applications for Anganwadi Karyakartri and Sahayika posts, as per the Government Order No. I/2025/3313/58-1-2025 (1917687), dated 17 September 2025, issued by the Principal Secretary, Bal Vikas Seva evam Pushtahar, Uttar Pradesh, Lucknow. The complete project-wise, gram sabha/ward-wise, and category-wise vacancy and eligibility details are displayed on the notice boards of the Collectorate, Vikas Bhavan, Tehsil and Vikas Khand offices, and Bal Vikas Pariyojana offices in Etah district, and are also uploaded on the departmental website. Apply Online / Notification Portal: http://upanganwadibharti.in Notification PDF Direct Link: Not specified (the notification refers candidates to the website above and to physical notice boards for the detailed ward/gram sabha-wise vacancy list)

content_sections.heading: Etah Anganwadi Karyakartri & Sahayika Vacancy Details 2026 (Project-Wise)
content_sections.text: Vacancies have been notified project-wise across nine Bal Vikas Pariyojana (Child Development Project) areas in Etah district, separately for the Karyakartri and Sahayika posts, with category-wise break-up under Unreserved (UR), Other Backward Class (OBC), and Scheduled Caste (SC). No vacancies have been notified under the Scheduled Tribe (ST) category in this notification. Note: The Karyakartri total (133) and Sahayika total (130) as stated in the notification match the sum of the project-wise figures shown. The full gram sabha/ward-wise vacancy list and reservation details are available on the Collectorate, Vikas Bhavan, Tehsil, Vikas Khand, and Bal Vikas Pariyojana office notice boards, and on the departmental website; these are not fully reproduced here as they were not part of the provided pages.

content_sections.heading: Etah Anganwadi Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Only women candidates are eligible for the notified posts. The minimum educational qualification for both the Anganwadi Karyakartri and Sahayika posts is Intermediate (12th pass) or an equivalent qualification. The maximum educational qualification considered is postgraduate level; merit will be prepared on this basis. Marks obtained in High School (10th) will not be included while preparing the merit list. The minimum age for candidates is 18 years and the maximum age is 35 years, as on the cut-off date of 01 July 2026. The date of birth recorded in the High School mark sheet and certificate will be treated as valid for age calculation. No separate age relaxation is available to candidates from Scheduled Caste, Other Backward Class, or General category. The candidate must necessarily be a resident of the ward (in urban areas) or gram panchayat against which the vacant post is notified.

content_sections.heading: Etah Anganwadi Recruitment 2026: Order of Preference for Selection
content_sections.text: For direct recruitment to Anganwadi Karyakartri and Sahayika posts, the following order of preference applies within the same gram sabha/ward: A widow woman from a Below Poverty Line (BPL) family, resident of that gram sabha/ward. A legally divorced/deserted woman from a BPL family, resident of that gram sabha/ward. If no candidate is available under the above two categories, women from BPL families in that gram sabha/ward. If no candidate is available under any of the above, in the same order of preference: a widow woman from an Above Poverty Line (APL) family; a legally divorced/deserted woman from an APL family; and if none is available, women from APL families in that gram sabha/ward. If no eligible candidate is available in any of the above categories within the gram sabha, category-wise selection will be made from within the concerned Nyaya Panchayat. For a widow candidate, a death certificate and family register copy issued/certified by the Gram Panchayat Officer or the concerned Nagar Nikay (Urban Local Body) will be valid proof. For a divorced/deserted woman, a valid legal order issued by a competent court will be required.

content_sections.heading: Etah Anganwadi Recruitment 2026: Merit and Selection Basis
content_sections.text: If more than one vacancy is notified in a gram sabha/ward and an applicant applies against all notified posts within her eligibility, selection will be based on whichever Anganwadi centre code is generated first on the portal for that applicant; no option/choice will be taken from the candidate in this regard, and once selection is finalised on the first-generated centre code, that applicant will not be considered for any other centre code. The gram panchayat/ward will be determined as per the current delimitation, and the reservation of the concerned Anganwadi centre will remain as it currently stands. Selected candidates who are already elected representatives (Gram Sabha member, Gram Pradhan, Kshetra Panchayat member, Kshetra Panchayat Adhyaksha, Nagar Palika member, or Sabhasad/Parshad, etc.) must resign from that position before joining; failure to do so will result in cancellation of their selection, and the responsibility for this rests solely with the candidate.

content_sections.heading: Etah Anganwadi Recruitment 2026: Nature of Post
content_sections.text: The Anganwadi Karyakartri and Sahayika posts are entirely temporary and honorarium-based. The Uttar Pradesh State Employee Service Rules do not apply to these posts, and the posts can be terminated at any time as directed by the Government. Two women from the same family will not be appointed as Karyakartri and Sahayika at the same Anganwadi centre.

faq.question: Q1. What is Etah Anganwadi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment drive by the District Programme Officer, Etah, Uttar Pradesh, to fill 263 honorarium-based Anganwadi Karyakartri and Sahayika posts across nine child development projects in Etah district.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in Etah Anganwadi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 263 vacancies in total — 133 for Anganwadi Karyakartri and 130 for Anganwadi Sahayika, spread across nine projects: Aligunj, Awagarh, Jaithra, Jalesar, Marahra, Nidhauli Kalan, Sakit, Sheetalpur, and Etah Shahar.

faq.question: Q3. Who can apply for Etah Anganwadi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Only women candidates who are residents of the ward or gram panchayat against which the post is vacant, and who meet the age and educational qualification criteria, can apply.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply for Etah Anganwadi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for online application is 17 August 2026, up to midnight.

faq.question: Q5. What is the educational qualification required for Etah Anganwadi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The minimum qualification is Intermediate (12th pass) or equivalent; the maximum qualification considered for merit is postgraduate level. Marks from High School (10th) are not counted in the merit list.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for Etah Anganwadi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The minimum age is 18 years and the maximum age is 35 years, as on the cut-off date of 01 July 2026. No separate age relaxation is available for any category.

faq.question: Q7. Is there an application fee for Etah Anganwadi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q8. How can I apply online for Etah Anganwadi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must apply online through http://upanganwadibharti.in within the prescribed window; offline or postal applications are not accepted.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection basis for Etah Anganwadi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection follows a fixed order of preference — starting with widowed and then legally divorced/deserted women from BPL families in the same gram sabha/ward, followed by other BPL and then APL category women — combined with merit prepared from educational qualification.

faq.question: Q10. Are these Anganwadi posts permanent government jobs?
faq.answer: No. The Anganwadi Karyakartri and Sahayika posts are entirely temporary and honorarium-based; Uttar Pradesh State Employee Service Rules do not apply, and the posts can be terminated at any time as directed by the Government.
